description: MCP server for ScalePad — Core, Lifecycle Manager, ControlMap, Backup Radar, and Quoter.
name: io.github.WYRE-AI/scalepad-mcp

environmentVariables.description: ScalePad platform API key (generated in the ScalePad app by an Administrator)
environmentVariables.name: SCALEPAD_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Data-residency region for ControlMap/Backup Radar: 'us' (default), 'eu', 'ca', or 'au'
environmentVariables.name: SCALEPAD_REGION

environmentVariables.description: Optional Quoter OAuth Client ID — only for the standalone api.quoter.com path
environmentVariables.name: QUOTER_CLIENT_ID

environmentVariables.description: Optional Quoter OAuth Client Secret, paired with QUOTER_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.name: QUOTER_CLIENT_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: Transport mode for the server. Set to 'stdio' for local CLI use; the image defaults to 'http' for gateway hosting.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT

environmentVariables.description: Credential source: 'env' reads vars locally, 'gateway' expects header injection from the WYRE MCP Gateway.
environmentVariables.name: AUTH_MODE

environmentVariables.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn, error
environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL

title: ScalePad
